sourceFacts.auctionHouseAlternative: Do not assume the toy is tradable; this route uses personal crafting.

steps.text: Visit Sean Catchpole, Stormshield. If Draenor Engineering is missing, purchase Draenor Engineering and use it to learn the tier. This route does not require a garrison.
steps.recovery: Open Engineering and switch its expansion selector to Draenor. Read the book’s live requirements before buying; a missing profession response is not proof that the tier is absent.

steps.text: Visit Nik Steelrings, Warspear. If Draenor Engineering is missing, purchase Draenor Engineering and use it to learn the tier. This route does not require a garrison.
steps.recovery: Open Engineering and switch its expansion selector to Draenor. Read the book’s live requirements before buying; a missing profession response is not proof that the tier is absent.

steps.text: If the toy recipe is still unlearned, craft one Secret of Draenor Engineering using Secrets of Draenor Engineering. It costs five True Iron Ore and shares the existing daily opportunity. Wait for its observed cooldown if needed.
steps.recovery: Open Draenor Engineering to observe the learned Secrets recipe and its current cooldown. Existing use history and charges stay shared with the cooldown routine.

steps.text: At Sean Catchpole, Stormshield, trade one Secret of Draenor Engineering for the Findle's Loot-A-Rang schematic. Inspect the price and make the purchase yourself.
At Nik Steelrings, Warspear, trade one Secret of Draenor Engineering for the Findle's Loot-A-Rang schematic. Inspect the price and make the purchase yourself.
Use the Findle's Loot-A-Rang schematic from your bags, then open Draenor Engineering to confirm the recipe is learned.
Collect 50 Gearspring Parts on this character. Use its learned Gearspring Parts variant as it becomes ready. Parts are bound to this character; do not plan an Auction House purchase of them.
steps.recovery: Use the learned daily or rechargeable Gearspring recipe and its observed state. No additional charge or completion is assumed; an existing Engineering Works is an optional work-order alternative.

steps.text: Open Draenor Engineering, select Findle's Loot-A-Rang, review the tools and 50 Gearspring Parts requirement, then craft one.
Use Findle's Loot-A-Rang from your bags to add it to the Toy Box.

routes.title: MOLL-E

steps.text: Visit Timofey Oshenko, Northrend Dalaran. Learn Northrend Engineering if needed. At Northrend Engineering 55, train MOLL-E. Open the matching expansion recipe list to confirm it is learned.
steps.recovery: This recipe requires Northrend Engineering 55. Open the trainer and the matching profession tier; a different expansion’s skill does not satisfy it.

steps.text: Prepare 8 Eternal Air, 8 Saronite Bar. Use your live recipe to confirm required tools; trade or gather these components yourself.
Select MOLL-E in Northrend Engineering and craft one using the prepared materials.
Use MOLL-E from your bags to learn it.

coverageGaps: Northrend Engineering skill leveling from an untrained character to 55 is not authored in this route; characters with the learned recipe can proceed directly.

routes.title: Tuskarr Traveling Soup Pot

sourceFacts.sourceScope: verify observed Warband or character reputation scope; do not manufacture character quest unlocks from account achievements

steps.text: Work toward Iskaara Tuskarr Renown 4. At Renown 2, complete Stolen Tuskaar Totems with Elder Poa and turn collected Sacred Tuskarr Totems in to her. At Renown 3, inspect Rowie’s Community Feasts introduction, then take Community Feast from Pleeqi when the event is active. Complete its five live tasks and turn it in; repeat the observed Feast opportunities and relevant reputation-awarding quests until the target rank.
steps.recovery: Open the faction reputation panel and visit its indicated quest giver to refresh access. Unknown data stays unknown; account achievements alone do not establish character-specific access.

steps.text: If Cooking Utensils is offered, complete it and choose Tuskarr Traveling Soup Pot when it is an available reward. Choose the reward yourself. Completing the quest without this toy does not grant ownership; buy any remaining toy below.
steps.recovery: Inspect the NPC’s offered quests. The reward choice is optional; if it is absent or already used, continue to the vendor purchase.

steps.text: Prepare 2 Serevite Ore, 100 Dragon Isles Supplies. This is the pinned purchase price; inspect the live vendor price before spending.
Visit Murik, Iskaara and buy Tuskarr Traveling Soup Pot if it is still missing. Check the displayed reputation requirement and price, then make the purchase yourself.
Use Tuskarr Traveling Soup Pot from your bags to add it to the Toy Box.

coverageGaps: Prerequisite Dragonflight faction introduction and early Renown 1–2 quest walkthrough is not covered inside this route; use existing observed unlocks or the connected progression guide.
unresolved: Prerequisite Dragonflight faction introduction and early Renown 1–2 quest walkthrough is not covered inside this route; use existing observed unlocks or the connected progression guide.

steps.text: Reach Maruuk Centaur Renown 3. Complete Orientation: Maruukai if offered. From Renown 2, take collected Centaur Hunting Trophies to Hunt Instructor Basku and choose an appropriate one-, five- or twenty-trophy turn-in yourself. Use actual reputation-awarding quests shown for this character. These toys unlock before Grand Hunts, so Hunts are not required.
steps.recovery: Open the faction reputation panel and visit its indicated quest giver to refresh access. Unknown data stays unknown; account achievements alone do not establish character-specific access.

steps.text: If Cultural Exchange is offered, complete it and choose Very Comfortable Pelt when it is an available reward. Choose the reward yourself. Completing the quest without this toy does not grant ownership; buy any remaining toy below.
steps.recovery: Inspect the NPC’s offered quests. The reward choice is optional; if it is absent or already used, continue to the vendor purchase.

steps.text: Prepare 2 Dense Hide, 100 Dragon Isles Supplies. This is the pinned purchase price; inspect the live vendor price before spending.
Visit Quartermaster Huseng, Maruukai and buy Very Comfortable Pelt if it is still missing. Check the displayed reputation requirement and price, then make the purchase yourself.
Use Very Comfortable Pelt from your bags to add it to the Toy Box.

routes.title: Niffen Diggin' Mitts

steps.text: Use the connected Loamm introduction and A Worthy Ally: Loamm Niffen weekly to work toward Renown 6. Complete actual reputation-awarding Zaralek activities until the observed rank reaches 6.
Speak with Newsy in Loamm and complete Like the Niffen Do to receive Niffen Diggin’ Mitts. This is a renown quest reward, not a reward inferred from the weekly.
Use Niffen Diggin’ Mitts from your bags to learn the toy.
